blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Philippine National Police (PNP) is pursuing a wider investigation to identify and dismantle the drug network behind the seizure of 67 kilograms of suspected shabu worth P455.6 million in Zamboanga City. A joint operation by the PNP and the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA) on Wednesday also led to the arrest of four suspects. “I have directed our units concerned to pursue the investigation beyond the four arrested suspects and establish the entire chain behind this illegal drug operation,” said PNP chief Gen.
